name: PAMAnaemiaCorrected
title: Anaemia corrected before surgery (PAM 15)
publisher: QH FHIR Connectathon 2026 — Track 1 (synthetic, not for clinical use)
description: Of the patients referred in the period who were anaemic at their first Hb (below 130 g/L male, 120 g/L female) and have a later Hb, the proportion whose latest Hb is at or above the threshold.
usage: Criteria are FHIRPath (text/fhirpath), evaluated once per patient with the context set to a Bundle of that patient's resources (as Patient/$everything would return). %periodStart and %periodEnd hold the measurement period as 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings. Uses defineVariable() and sort() from FHIRPath 3.0 (fhirpath.js 4+). Evaluated by ../evaluate-measures.mjs; a production version would use CQL on a server with $evaluate-measure.

criteria.expression: entry.resource.ofType(ServiceRequest).where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' and code = '3457005').exists() and authoredOn.toDate() >= %periodStart.toDate() and authoredOn.toDate() <= %periodEnd.toDate()).exists()

population.description: Anaemic at the first Hb, with a later Hb

criteria.expression: entry.resource.ofType(ServiceRequest).where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' and code = '3457005').exists() and authoredOn.toDate() >= %periodStart.toDate() and authoredOn.toDate() <= %periodEnd.toDate()).exists() and defineVariable('hb', entry.resource.ofType(Observation).where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '718-7').exists() and status = 'final' and value.exists()).sort(effective)).defineVariable('threshold', iif(entry.resource.ofType(Patient).gender = 'female', 120, 130)).select(%hb.count() >= 2 and %hb.first().value.value < %threshold)

population.description: Latest Hb at or above the sex-specific threshold

criteria.expression: entry.resource.ofType(ServiceRequest).where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' and code = '3457005').exists() and authoredOn.toDate() >= %periodStart.toDate() and authoredOn.toDate() <= %periodEnd.toDate()).exists() and defineVariable('hb', entry.resource.ofType(Observation).where(code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org' and code = '718-7').exists() and status = 'final' and value.exists()).sort(effective)).defineVariable('threshold', iif(entry.resource.ofType(Patient).gender = 'female', 120, 130)).select(%hb.count() >= 2 and %hb.first().value.value < %threshold and %hb.last().value.value >= %threshold)
